title: Submarine with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water hint: small light waves, kept simple and bright -->
  <path d='M6 78 Q14 72 22 78 T38 78' fill='none' stroke='#5fd3ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 84 Q70 78 78 84 T94 84' fill='none' stroke='#5fd3ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M10 88 Q18 82 26 88 T42 88' fill='none' stroke='#5fd3ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- periscope -->
  <rect x='47' y='24' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <rect x='51' y='22' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffd27a'/>
  <rect x='57' y='23' width='2' height='3' fill='#7fe8ff'/>

  <!-- propeller -->
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='58' rx='4' ry='10' fill='#ffd27a'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='58' rx='3' ry='8' fill='#ff9b3d'/>
  <rect x='78' y='56' width='6' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <!-- hull -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='58' rx='34' ry='17' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='53' rx='32' ry='11' fill='#ffca6e'/>
  <!-- belly band for contrast -->
  <path d='M14 64 Q46 78 78 64 Q70 74 46 75 Q22 74 14 64 Z' fill='#ff9b3d'/>

  <!-- conning tower -->
  <path d='M36 44 Q36 33 46 33 Q56 33 56 44 Z' fill='#ff9b3d'/>
  <rect x='39' y='37' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7fe8ff'/>

  <!-- porthole -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='55' r='5' fill='#7fe8ff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#bff7ff'/>

  <!-- smiling face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='54' r='3' fill='#2a2140'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='54' r='1.4' fill='#bff7ff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='54' r='3' fill='#2a2140'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='54' r='1.4' fill='#bff7ff'/>
  <path d='M38 61 Q48 69 58 61' fill='none' stroke='#2a2140' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='59' r='2' fill='#ff7a8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='59' r='2' fill='#ff7a8a' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='3' fill='#bff7ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='2' fill='#bff7ff'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='37' r='1.8' fill='#bff7ff'/>
</svg>
